entries.text: MCP run_benchmark now returns the result integrity validator's verdict (PASS, WARN or FAIL with the non-passing checks) in an integrity field of a completed run, the same verdict validate_results gives for the result file.

MCP run_benchmark now returns an MCP error (is_error true) with the cause when a run ends without a result file, because the result export failed, no result was produced, or execution raised, instead of a normal response with status incomplete.

Reused TPC-H databases are now checked against exact row counts for orders, customer, part, partsupp, supplier, nation and region, and a tight lineitem range, so a database whose tables no longer hold the generated rows, such as one changed by earlier refresh inserts, is recreated instead of reused and returning different query results.
compare now refuses, with the not-comparable exit code, a pair where one side is an MCP result from before MCP and CLI runs shared compression and platform-option defaults.
Platform option values taken from the applied run configuration are now labelled applied_defaults in platform_option_sources. Earlier results keep the saved_config label, which still reads as before.
benchbox results validate on a directory no longer reports non-result JSON files, such as an inventory index, as FAIL; a malformed result or unreadable JSON still fails.
benchbox submit now names the actual benchmark when it refuses an unofficial result, instead of always naming TPC-DS.
A manifest sidecar can carry a known_defect_reason beside known_defects, and each known defect id has a default reason; the explorer pipeline records it as known_defect_reason on excluded results.
